fusions.name: Winnowing Curtain
fusions.desc: Raises a wall of wings 5 tiles long for 6 seconds, dragging every enemy near it inward and dealing 6 damage to what it catches and stunning it for 1 second. Anything struck moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Hobbling Shot
fusions.desc: Throws a sting that deals 8 damage and pins the target [Pinned] for 2 seconds. The sting then leaps to 1 more enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 60% of the original damage. It uses up to 4 charges, and kills return one.

fusions.name: Call to the Comb
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 5 enemies within 8 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Catch and Hold
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, a bolt leaps to the nearest enemy within 9.5 tiles, dealing 6 damage. Once every 10 seconds.
